_about: The Black Friday page, /black-friday/, built by scripts/build-black-friday.mjs. Times are UTC: the sale opens Thu Nov 19, 2026, 8am Jamaica time (13:00Z) and ends Mon Nov 30, 11:59pm Jamaica time (04:59:59Z on Dec 1). The countdown on the page and the bar snippet (snippets/bf-countdown-bar.html) use the same two times. Deals go in the deals list as the hotels release them; until then the page shows the lanes with 'Deals land Nov 19'. A deal: name, img (site path), alt, was (the usual from-price, US$), from (the Black Friday from-price, US$, null until known: the tile then shows the usual price and 'Black Friday rate Nov 19'), trip and where (they fill the dates form when an unpriced tile is tapped), basis (e.g. 'per person per night'), line, lane (staycations | visitors | getaways), wa (the WhatsApp message) or href, until (YYYY-MM-DD, optional, Jamaica date: the tile drops off after it). The form (form) saves to the Netlify form bf-early (no WhatsApp step); the team replies by WhatsApp or email. In the form they either give their own dates (when: My dates, checkin, checkout) or ask for the cheapest dates (when: Cheapest dates, months: the months they tapped, nights: how many nights).
